material.title: Acme Marketplace announces a fulfillment fee change
material.bodyOriginal: Acme Marketplace announced a fulfillment fee change effective November 1, 2026 for US sellers only. The fee changes from $3.00 to $3.50 per parcel. Other regions and storage fees are unchanged.
